Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: A photo or memory asset stored permanently in Firebase

photoId.description: Unique identifier for the photo placement slot

url.description: Image URL, asset path, or cloud image URL

title.description: Title or caption of the photo

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of when the photo was saved

SongCover.title: SongCover
SongCover.description: Permanent cover art for a music plaque shown on every device

songId.description: Identifier of the song plaque (e.g. h1, h2, h3, b1, b2, b3)

coverUrl.description: Public URL or image asset path of the cover art

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of when the cover was saved

MusicTrack.title: MusicTrack
MusicTrack.description: Permanent music track configuration stored in Firebase

/photos/{photoId}.description: Collection of permanent photos accessible across all devices

/songCovers/{songId}.description: Collection of permanent song plaque covers accessible across all devices

/music/{trackId}.description: Collection of permanent soundtrack audio tracks stored in Firebase
